_doc: Frozen, versioned normalization artifact. Computed from the TRAIN SPLIT ONLY (episodes.split='train'), streamed via Welford/Chan over shards, then re-applied byte-identically at val/test/inference. A model card pins (git_sha, dvc_dataset_hash, artifact_version, registry_version) to make any run reproducible. Methods: zscore{mean,std} | minmax{min,max} | robust{median,iqr} | log1p_zscore{mean,std after log1p} | sincos{} (parameter-free) | divide_period{period} (parameter-free constant denom) | identity{}. `clip` is applied BEFORE the transform when present.
_doc_v2: v2 (4on4) additions: global.time_since_seen (belief), global.team_spread, global.audio_intensity; sincos adds rel_bearing/rel_pitch/audio_dir; divide_period adds ammo caps sh/nl/rk/cl (entity health/armor reuse the existing /250 //200 divide_period; quad/pent/ring_remaining reused for self AND entities). Schema tag stays komodobots.normalization_stats.v1 (artifact shape unchanged). Entity rel_vel REUSES per_map.<map>.vel_x/y/z; rel_dist is identity-after-/diagonal (no fitted key). dm3 AABB is asymmetric and VERIFIED — do not replace with a blanket +-2048.
_doc_v3: v3 (turn-direction) addition: per_map.<map>.yaw_rate (zscore) — the REQUIRED key the appended SELF feature yaw_rate_z z-scores against (shard_contract.REQUIRED_NORM_KEYS). face_vel_angle_norm is parameter-free (signed /180) and needs NO fitted key. SELF vector is now 18-wide (the frozen-16 + yaw_rate_z + face_vel_angle_norm). A v2 stats artifact (no yaw_rate) is REJECTED by shard_contract.check_norm_artifact.
_doc_v4: v4 (route-conditioning) addition: the SELF vector gained goal_heading_sincos[2] + goal_dist_norm (now 21-wide). Both are PARAMETER-FREE (sincos + /map_diagonal identity) and need NO fitted key, so REQUIRED_NORM_KEYS is unchanged at v4 (still just yaw_rate) and this artifact's per_map is byte-identical to v3 — only registry_version bumps 3 -> 4. The goal is supplied per tick (offline: hindsight next-resource; live: tactical layer), never fitted.
_doc_v5: v5 (sequence-aware: GRU over a goal-conditioned short history) change: NO new normalization keys. The SELF channels are UNCHANGED (still the 21-wide v4 goal-conditioned vector), so the SAME per-channel stats (incl. yaw_rate) are re-applied byte-identically to EACH of the SELF_HISTORY=16 history rows the policy now consumes (the self_history field, width 16*21=336). registry_version is bumped to 5 only because the obs CONTRACT (shape) changed; per_map stats are identical to v4. A pre-v5 stamp (registry_version<5) is rejected by shard_contract.check_norm_artifact.
split_def: grouped_by_demo_id (held-out players: [milton] reserved for style-generalization test)
dataset_version: TEMPLATE — dvc hash of the silver corpus

computed_with.note: ddof=0 (population std) to match sklearn StandardScaler.

jump_cadence._note: Filled from _inventory.md exact-player cadences (44.9/44.0/48.6). Real value needs full train corpus.

time_since_pickup._note: mean/std are of log1p(elapsed_seconds). PLACEHOLDER numbers.

time_since_seen._note: v2 belief feature: mean/std of log1p(seconds since observer last saw target). PLACEHOLDER.

team_spread._note: v2: mean pairwise teammate distance (qu). PLACEHOLDER.

audio_intensity._note: v2: decayed audio-cue intensity (already roughly [0,1]). PLACEHOLDER; could also be divide_period if a fixed cap is preferred.

dm3._note_v2: Entity rel_vel REUSES these vel_x/y/z zscore keys (egocentric-rotated velocity, same scale). Entity rel_dist is identity-after-/diagonal (no fitted key here). dm3 AABB below is asymmetric and VERIFIED from maps.v1 — Gemini's blanket +-2048 is WRONG; do not symmetrize.

pos_x._note: min/max ARE the dm3 AABB bounds from maps.v1 — these are real, not placeholders.

vel_x._note: PLACEHOLDER mean/std (illustrative; ~maxspeed-scale). Compute on train shards.

hspeed._note: median near server maxspeed 320; iqr placeholder.

yaw_rate._note: Turn-direction signal: signed view-yaw rate (deg/s) = wrap180(yaw[t]-yaw[t-1])/dt, fitted from consecutive-tick deltas via the SHARED agent_observation.yaw_rate_degps. SELF feature yaw_rate_z z-scores against this. face_vel_angle_norm needs NO fitted key (parameter-free signed /180 scalar). std placeholder; fit on train shards.

dm2._note: Same key set as dm3; min/max from maps.v1 dm2 AABB [1152,-2592,-184]..[3008,352,576]. Velocity/speed stats fit on dm2 train shards.

divide_period._note: Item *_remaining periods MIRROR item_catalog.dm3.json respawn_seconds (carry the same _verify caveats). eta_cap is the ETA clamp CAP. These are constants, not fitted.
divide_period._note_v2: Ammo caps sh/nl/rk/cl (shells/nails/rockets/cells) for ammo_per_weapon_norm — PLACEHOLDER caps, confirm against KTX max ammo. quad/pent/ring_remaining are reused for BOTH self powerup_remaining AND entity_powerup_remaining.
